title.zh-TW: 黃仁勳辭任 Nvidia 執行長
title.en: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO

summary.zh-TW: AI 晶片龍頭最高領導人即刻離任。美股 Nvidia 收跌，台股隔天卻反彈，是觀察「同一事件、不同市場反應」的典型案例。
summary.en: The AI chip leader's chief executive left with immediate effect. Nvidia fell in the US, yet Taiwan stocks rebounded the next day: a clear case of one event drawing different market reactions.

facts.zh-TW: 黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，即刻生效；財務長 Colette Kress 出任臨時執行長。
facts.en: Huang stepped down as president, CEO and director, effective immediately; CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO.

facts.zh-TW: Harvey C. Jones 出任 Nvidia 首任董事會主席，主導新執行長遴選，人選將考慮公司內外部。
facts.en: Harvey C. Jones became Nvidia's first board chair and will lead the search, weighing internal and external candidates.

facts.zh-TW: 辭任原因各媒體報導不一，本站不轉述未經證實的指控。
facts.en: Reported reasons vary across outlets; we don't repeat unverified allegations.

work.zh-TW: 據自由財經報導，Nvidia 董事會表示公司營運、客戶承諾與產品路線圖預期不受影響。
work.en: According to Liberty Times Finance, Nvidia's board said operations, customer commitments and the product roadmap are expected to be unaffected.

work.zh-TW: 目前未見 CUDA 等開發工具或授權條款的變更公告；觀察重點是新任執行長人選與產品策略是否延續。
work.en: No changes to CUDA or other developer tools or licensing have been announced. Worth watching: who the next CEO is and whether product strategy holds.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 重大新聞發生後，常出現假冒新聞連結或「內幕消息」的釣魚信與詐騙投資訊息。
securityPatterns.en: Big news is routinely followed by phishing that poses as news links or "inside information", and by investment scams.

move.zh-TW: 一度跌逾 700 點，收漲 548 點

move.en: opened +1.46%, up over 1,200 points in early trade

basis.en: Nov 13 early trade, not a close

views.zh-TW: 中央社將台股 11/13 的走高描述為「短期利空出盡」的反應。
views.en: CNA described Taiwan's Nov 13 rise as a reaction to the bad news being priced in.

views.zh-TW: 自由財經報導，投資人資金轉向 AMD 與博通等 Nvidia 競爭對手，兩者皆上漲超過 5%。
views.en: Liberty Times Finance reported investors moving into Nvidia rivals AMD and Broadcom, both up more than 5%.

caveats.zh-TW: 同一週美國消費者物價指數高於預期，市場也在等待生產者物價指數，這些總體因素同樣影響股價。
caveats.en: US consumer prices came in above expectations that week and producer prices were still due; such macro factors also move stocks.

caveats.zh-TW: 台股 11/12 的下跌發生在正式宣布之前，當時市場已有相關人事傳聞，不能全部歸因於這次宣布。
caveats.en: Taiwan's Nov 12 drop came before the official announcement, while personnel rumors were already circulating, so it can't all be attributed to the announcement.

caveats.zh-TW: Nvidia 股價在宣布前一個月已下跌超過兩成。
caveats.en: Nvidia's stock had already fallen more than 20% over the prior month.

text.zh-TW: 黃仁勳宣布辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，Colette Kress 出任臨時執行長。
text.en: Huang resigned as president, CEO and director; Colette Kress named interim CEO.

text.zh-TW: 加權指數早盤漲逾 1,200 點。
text.en: TAIEX rose more than 1,200 points in early trade.

nextWatch.zh-TW: 新任執行長人選，以及產品路線圖是否延續。
nextWatch.en: Who becomes the next CEO, and whether the product roadmap holds.

what.zh-TW: 黃仁勳辭任 Nvidia 執行長，由財務長暫代。
what.en: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO; the CFO is interim CEO.

impact.zh-TW: 目前沒有 CUDA 等開發工具或授權的變更公告。
impact.en: No changes to CUDA or other developer tools or licensing have been announced.

action.zh-TW: 留意新任執行長人選與產品路線圖。
action.en: Watch for the next CEO and the product roadmap.

title.zh-TW: Outlook 零時差漏洞遭實際利用
title.en: Outlook zero-day exploited in the wild

summary.zh-TW: 企業每天都在用的 Outlook 出現已遭利用的漏洞，可能外洩登入憑證。分數不高，卻是本月唯一已遭利用的微軟漏洞。
summary.en: Outlook, used across workplaces every day, has an exploited flaw that can leak sign-in credentials. Its score is modest, yet it's the only exploited Microsoft flaw this month.

facts.zh-TW: 微軟 11/10 例行更新修補 CVE-2026-124194，屬於 Outlook 欺騙漏洞，CVSS 6.5，微軟確認已遭利用。
facts.en: Microsoft's Nov 10 update fixed CVE-2026-124194, an Outlook spoofing flaw rated CVSS 6.5 that Microsoft confirmed is being exploited.

facts.zh-TW: 開啟特製的郵件檔案時，Outlook 可能在未警告的情況下連線到外部伺服器，外洩使用者的 NTLMv2 雜湊值。
facts.en: Opening a crafted message file can make Outlook connect to an outside server without warning, leaking the user's NTLMv2 hash.

facts.zh-TW: 美國 CISA 已列入已遭利用漏洞清單，要求聯邦機構於 11/24 前完成修補。
facts.en: CISA added it to its known-exploited list, giving federal agencies until Nov 24 to patch.

work.zh-TW: IT 部門可能推送 Office 更新並要求重新啟動 Outlook；建議確認更新確實已安裝到自己的電腦上。
work.en: IT may push Office updates and ask you to restart Outlook. Check that the update has actually landed on your machine.

work.zh-TW: 在修補完成前，對來路不明的附件或郵件檔案要特別小心。
work.en: Until it's patched, be especially careful with unexpected attachments and message files.

securityFacts.zh-TW: 資安媒體建議除了安裝更新，也考慮限制對外的 NTLM 驗證與連往不受信任主機的 SMB 連線。
securityFacts.en: Security outlets advise installing the update and also limiting outbound NTLM authentication and SMB connections to untrusted hosts.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 外洩的 NTLM 雜湊值常被用於中繼攻擊或離線破解，進一步取得帳號存取權。
securityPatterns.en: Leaked NTLM hashes are commonly used in relay attacks or cracked offline to gain account access.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 重大漏洞公開後，常出現假冒「緊急更新」的釣魚信，要求使用者點連結或下載檔案。
securityPatterns.en: After a major flaw goes public, fake "urgent update" emails asking users to click links or download files are common.

caveats.zh-TW: 我們未找到將當天跌幅與此漏洞或例行更新連結的報導，因此不推論兩者有因果關係。
caveats.en: We found no reporting linking that day's drop to this flaw or the update, so we draw no causal link.

caveats.zh-TW: 例行安全更新每月都會發布，通常不被市場視為重大事件。
caveats.en: Security updates ship every month and usually aren't treated as major market events.

caveats.zh-TW: 台股方面沒有直接相關的上市公司，因此不列出。
caveats.en: No directly related company is listed in Taiwan, so none is shown.

text.zh-TW: 微軟例行更新修補 CVE-2026-124194，確認已遭利用。
text.en: Microsoft's monthly update fixed CVE-2026-124194, confirmed as exploited.

text.zh-TW: CISA 列入已遭利用漏洞清單。
text.en: CISA added it to its known-exploited list.

text.zh-TW: 美國聯邦機構修補期限。
text.en: Deadline for US federal agencies to patch.

nextWatch.zh-TW: 是否出現更多攻擊報告，以及企業的修補進度。
nextWatch.en: Whether more attack reports surface, and how quickly organizations patch.

what.zh-TW: Outlook 漏洞遭實際利用，可能外洩登入憑證。
what.en: An exploited Outlook flaw can leak sign-in credentials.

impact.zh-TW: 開啟特製的郵件檔案就可能中招。
impact.en: Opening a crafted message file can be enough.

action.zh-TW: 確認 11 月的 Office 更新已安裝。
action.en: Make sure November's Office update is installed.

title.zh-TW: Microsoft 365 大規模斷線：Outlook、Teams、Copilot 受影響
title.en: Major Microsoft 365 outage hits Outlook, Teams and Copilot

summary.zh-TW: 美東時間 11/12 下午（台灣時間 11/13 凌晨）起，全球大量用戶無法收發信件。這正是軟體人最常遇到的情境：一個雲端服務停擺，連帶影響工作、資安與依賴它的 AI 整合。
summary.en: From the afternoon of Nov 12 US Eastern time, users worldwide couldn't send or receive email. It's the scenario engineers know best: one cloud service goes down and work, security and the AI integrations built on it go down with it.

facts.zh-TW: 美東時間 11/12 下午 1 點過後，Downdetector 上回報 Outlook 問題的美國用戶一度接近 13 萬人。
facts.en: Shortly after 1 p.m. ET on Nov 12, nearly 130,000 US users reported Outlook problems on Downdetector.

facts.zh-TW: 微軟起初表示問題出現在美洲，之後確認全球任何地區的 Microsoft 365 連線都可能受影響；Downdetector 統計波及 74 個國家和地區。
facts.en: Microsoft first pointed to the Americas, then confirmed Microsoft 365 connectivity could be affected in any region; Downdetector counted 74 countries and territories.

facts.zh-TW: 微軟表示，部分基礎設施在多個區域出現負載過高，可能是連線錯誤的原因；已暫停所有部署、轉移流量並重新啟動受影響的伺服器。
facts.en: Microsoft said elevated load on part of its infrastructure across regions was likely behind the errors; it paused all deployments, moved traffic and restarted affected servers.

facts.zh-TW: 部分伺服器恢復後，一旦流量回流又會再度無回應；截至查證時（台灣時間 11/13），微軟尚未宣布完全恢復。
facts.en: Some servers became unresponsive again once traffic returned. As of our check (Nov 13, Taiwan time), Microsoft hadn't declared full recovery.

work.zh-TW: 受影響的服務包括 Exchange Online、Teams、SharePoint Online、Copilot 365、Defender XDR、Planner、To Do 與 Intune，等於企業日常協作工具大多停擺。
work.en: Affected services included Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, Copilot 365, Defender XDR, Planner, To Do and Intune: most of a company's daily collaboration stack.

work.zh-TW: 路透社報導，OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的 AI 服務所使用的 Microsoft 365 連接器也受到波及。依賴 M365 的自動化流程與 AI 整合，可能在你沒察覺的情況下中斷。
work.en: Reuters reported the outage also hit Microsoft 365 connectors used by OpenAI's and Anthropic's AI services. Automations and AI integrations that depend on M365 may fail without you noticing.

work.zh-TW: 實務上可以先查看 Microsoft 365 服務狀態頁或系統管理中心的事件公告、改用備用溝通管道，並在服務恢復後確認是否有漏收的信件與排程。
work.en: In practice: check the Microsoft 365 status page or admin center incident notice, switch to a backup channel, and once service returns, check for missed mail and scheduled jobs.

securityFacts.zh-TW: 澳洲內政部長表示，微軟告知他們不認為這次斷線是網路攻擊造成的。
securityFacts.en: Australia's home affairs minister said Microsoft told him it didn't believe the outage was caused by a cyberattack.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 大型服務中斷期間，常出現假冒「帳號異常，請重新登入」或「服務已恢復，請驗證身分」的釣魚信。
securityPatterns.en: During major outages, phishing posing as "unusual account activity, sign in again" or "service restored, verify your identity" is common.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 員工可能改用個人信箱或未經核准的工具傳送公司資料，造成資料外洩風險。
securityPatterns.en: Staff may switch to personal email or unapproved tools to send company data, creating leak risks.

securityPatterns.zh-TW: 同一週 Outlook 才剛修補一個已遭利用的零時差漏洞（見下方卡片），IT 部門應確認修補沒有因這次斷線而延誤。
securityPatterns.en: The same week, Outlook had just been patched for an exploited zero-day (see the card below); IT should make sure that patching wasn't delayed by the outage.

basis.en: Nov 12 close; outage began during trading
Nov 12 after hours, not a regular close

caveats.zh-TW: 同一天 Nvidia 宣布執行長辭任，牽動整個 AI 類股，也會影響微軟等大型科技股的走勢。
caveats.en: Nvidia announced its CEO's resignation the same day, moving the whole AI sector, including large tech stocks like Microsoft.

caveats.zh-TW: 斷線在收盤後仍未完全排除，後續股價反應有待觀察，本卡片會在下次更新時補上。
caveats.en: The outage wasn't fully resolved after the close; any later price reaction remains to be seen, and this card will be updated.

caveats.zh-TW: 台股方面沒有直接相關的上市公司，因此不列出。
caveats.en: No directly related company is listed in Taiwan, so none is shown.

text.zh-TW: 用戶回報量急升，Downdetector 上回報 Outlook 問題的美國用戶接近 13 萬人。
text.en: Reports spiked; nearly 130,000 US users reported Outlook problems on Downdetector.

text.zh-TW: 微軟讓部分伺服器恢復服務，但表示伺服器在流量回流後可能再次無回應。
text.en: Microsoft returned some servers to service but said they could become unresponsive again once traffic returned.

text.zh-TW: 微軟表示部分伺服器再度無回應，之後開始擴充容量以承接回流的流量。
text.en: Microsoft said some servers were unresponsive again, then began adding capacity for returning traffic.

text.zh-TW: 斷線延續到週五早上，微軟仍在修復中。
text.en: The outage stretched into Friday morning as Microsoft kept working on a fix.

nextWatch.zh-TW: 完全恢復的時間，以及微軟是否發布事後檢討報告說明根本原因。
nextWatch.en: When service fully recovers, and whether Microsoft publishes a post-incident review with the root cause.

topic.zh-TW: 斷線對微軟股價的影響
topic.en: How the outage affected Microsoft's stock

claim.zh-TW: 股價未受影響，當天小幅收高。
claim.en: Shares weren't affected and closed slightly higher.

verdict.zh-TW: 以收盤數據為準：微軟 11/12 收漲 0.36%（523.00 美元），沒有證據顯示斷線造成股價下跌。FX Leaders 的說法與數據不符。
verdict.en: We go by the close: Microsoft rose 0.36% to $523.00 on Nov 12, with no evidence the outage pushed it down. FX Leaders' claim doesn't match the data.

what.zh-TW: Microsoft 365 全球斷線，Outlook、Teams、Copilot 受影響。
what.en: A global Microsoft 365 outage hit Outlook, Teams and Copilot.

impact.zh-TW: 收發信件與依賴 Microsoft 365 的 AI 整合可能中斷。
impact.en: Email and AI integrations that depend on Microsoft 365 may fail.

action.zh-TW: 查看服務狀態頁，留意假冒「重新登入」的釣魚信。
action.en: Check the status page and watch for fake "sign in again" phishing.
